description: Implementation of QuicSpdyClientBase class handling QUIC and HTTP/2 (SPDY) client operations, including request sending, response handling, session management, and data resending logic.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientBase
classes.description: A base class for QUIC clients supporting SPDY/HTTP2, managing sessions, requests, responses, and data resending.

classes.name: QuicDataToResend
classes.description: Represents data that can be resent over a QUIC connection, including headers, body, and fin flag.

classes.name: ClientQuicDataToResend
classes.description: Derived class for resending client request data.

methods.name: Resend
methods.description: Re-sends the stored request data.

methods.name: QuicDataToResend constructor
methods.description: Initializes a QuicDataToResend object with headers, body, and fin flag.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientBase constructor
methods.description: Initializes the client with server ID, supported versions, config, helper, alarm factory, network helper, proof verifier, and session cache.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientBase destructor
methods.description: Cleans up the client, including resetting the session.

methods.name: client_session
methods.description: Returns the current client session as QuicSpdyClientSession.

methods.name: InitializeSession
methods.description: Initializes the session, setting header size limits and starting crypto handshake.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure, stores response headers and body if configured.

methods.name: CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC client session.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Prepares and sends an HTTP/2 request, converting headers to lowercase if configured.

methods.name: SendRequestInternal
methods.description: Internal method to send a request with sanitized headers.

methods.name: SendRequestAndWaitForResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and blocks until response is received.

methods.name: SendRequestsAndWaitForResponse
methods.description: Sends multiple requests from URL list and waits for responses.

methods.name: CreateClientStream
methods.description: Creates a new client stream if connected.

methods.name: goaway_received
methods.description: Checks if GOAWAY was received from server.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Checks if inchoate reject was received.

methods.name: GetNumSentClientHellosFromSession
methods.description: Returns number of client hellos sent.

methods.name: GetNumReceivedServerConfigUpdatesFromSession
methods.description: Returns number of server config updates received.

methods.name: MaybeAddQuicDataToResend
methods.description: Adds data to resend queue upon connection.

methods.name: ClearDataToResend
methods.description: Clears the data to resend queue.

methods.name: ResendSavedData
methods.description: Resends all stored data.

methods.name: AddPromiseDataToResend
methods.description: Stores promise data for potential resend.

methods.name: CheckVary
methods.description: Checks Vary headers for request/response matching.

methods.name: OnRendezvousResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a rendezvous attempt, resending data if needed.

methods.name: latest_response_code
methods.description: Returns the latest response status code.

methods.name: latest_response_headers
methods.description: Returns the latest response headers as string.

methods.name: preliminary_response_headers
methods.description: Returns the preliminary response headers.

methods.name: latest_response_header_block
methods.description: Returns the latest response headers as Http2HeaderBlock.

methods.name: latest_response_body
methods.description: Returns the latest response body.

methods.name: latest_response_trailers
methods.description: Returns the latest response trailers.

methods.name: HasActiveRequests
methods.description: Checks if there are active request streams.
